findings.claim_text: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents went from a random seed to "Free the End" in 27h14m on Java 1.20.4 at Easy difficulty.
A Claude Opus 5 agent killed the dragon a month earlier, in 3h56m, using 37 human-written tools.
ARC Prize verified Argon on ARC-AGI-3 at 49.8% with its standard harness and 97.5% with Google's "provider adapter" harness at low reasoning.
